title: 第十九章 f7第二十章 你找错人了
slug: 兽校开局被强吻我被疯批们娇宠
content_zh:
“他不是听到我们谈话才决定找上简妤的，我们不过是推动他出手的加速剂。”
对方有没有闻到简妤身上的那股香，盛越不知道。
但他懂凌厌执对一个人产生兴趣时的眼神，是什么样子。
“可能没有多喜欢，但他第一眼感官上不喜欢的人，深入交流的**都不会有。”
盛越能感受到凌厌执对简妤的**，不算深刻，可是显眼又刺眼。
“废话。”裴殷气得额角抽了抽，“都黏糊成那样了，他怕不是连脚都想舔。”
盛越皱眉，“你是变态吗？”
裴殷：“？？？”
他深呼一口气，“他故意误导我们，怎么，怕我们抢？”
盛越眼睛抬了抬，“不只是误导我们，我抱简妤离开教室不过几分钟，他就在网上推波助澜，发了不少引火的帖子。”
他提醒裴殷：“还记得昨晚他突然问你的问题吗？我们做实验都是用第二天执行死刑的罪犯，别人不清楚就算了，他不可能不知道。”
盛越双手环胸，后退两步，半靠在墙上。
“刻意引导你说出实验体死亡的事情，拿你刺激简妤。等简妤对你我产生惧意，他再站出来做好人。”
他眼皮低垂，“你觉得他想做什么？”
自然是想营造出外面很危险，只有凌厌执这里才是最安全的错觉。
他们七个人，总是不受控制地喜欢上同一个东西。
人人能分的东西，倒是不用太伤兄弟感情，可简妤只有一个。
而凌厌执，他最讨厌别人跟他抢。
裴殷脱下衣服，骂骂咧咧，“自私，阴险的狗东西。”
不对，他那么生气做什么？

他又没打算跟凌厌执抢。
心里反复念叨，时刻提醒自己。
裴殷眼睛斜睨，发现盛越浑身散发出一股低落的气息，“你怎么了？”
“她为什么退我钱？”盛越一开始没有在意。
至少收到退款信息的时候，他是无动于衷的。
“询问费。我转给她一百万星币，她退回来了。”
裴殷阴阳怪气：“嗤，钱都不要？那你就继续送呗，学学人家凌狗，哄着她收。”
他冷哼，“既然要玩，大家就玩大一点。”
裴殷转头就把所有信息匿名发给了简妤。
他看着席郁昨晚发来的那条信息：谁派来的？
没调查？那他不介意把水再搅浑一点。
裴殷冷笑回复：你觉得是谁派的？
思考片刻，裴殷又点进群聊，其他人不在帝都星，但段斐也在啊。
论实力，席郁第一，但段斐也的腹黑程度，丝毫不比凌厌执低。
裴殷不想争什么女人，他现在就想着看凌狗吃瘪，看他们狗咬狗。
他搞事情地发出一条信息：去看学院论坛。
得到一个秒回。
段斐也：无聊。
裴殷直接甩他几个帖子链接，附带凌厌执大名，看他还无不无聊。
见对面没了消息，他满意地关闭星脑。

不能只有他一个人无聊。
盛越淡淡地抬了抬眼，面色寡淡，“你做了什么？”
裴殷理直气壮：“摇人。”
大早上跑过来告诉他，不就是想让他同一阵营，再拉几个人来对抗凌狗？
盛越了解凌厌执的为人。
content_en:
"He didn't decide to find Jian Yu after hearing our conversation. We were just the accelerator that pushed him to take action."
Sheng Yue didn't know whether the other party smelled the fragrance on Jian Yu's body.
But he knew what Ling Yanzhi's eyes looked like when he became interested in someone.
"Maybe he doesn't like her that much, but he won't have the chance to have in-depth communication with anyone he doesn't like at first sight."
Sheng Yue could feel Ling Yanzhi's lust for Jian Yu. It wasn't profound, but it was conspicuous and dazzling.
"Nonsense." Pei Yin's forehead twitched in anger, "It's so sticky. I'm afraid he even wants to lick his feet."
Sheng Yue frowned, "Are you a pervert?"
Pei Yin: "???"
He took a deep breath and said, "He deliberately misled us. Why, are you afraid that we will rob him?"
Sheng Yue raised his eyes and said, "Not only did he mislead us, but just a few minutes after I took Jian Yu out of the classroom, he started to add fuel to the fire and posted a lot of inflammatory posts on the Internet."
He reminded Pei Yin: "Do you remember the question he suddenly asked you last night? We always use criminals who are executed the next day for experiments. It doesn't matter if others don't know. There is no way he doesn't know."
Sheng Yue crossed his arms over his chest, took two steps back, and half leaned against the wall.
"I deliberately led you to tell you about the death of the experimental subject, and used you to stimulate Jian Yu. When Jian Yu becomes afraid of you and me, he will stand up and be a good person."
His eyelids lowered, "What do you think he wants to do?"
Naturally, he wanted to create the illusion that it was dangerous outside and that Ling Yanzhi was the safest place.
The seven of them always fall in love with the same thing uncontrollably.
It's something that everyone can share, so there's no need to hurt the brothers' feelings too much, but there's only one Jian Yu.
As for Ling Yanzhi, he hates it most when others compete with him.
Pei Yin took off his clothes and cursed, "Selfish, insidious bitch."
No, why is he so angry?
He had no intention of fighting with Ling Yan.
I repeat it over and over again in my mind, reminding myself all the time.
Pei Yin squinted his eyes and noticed that Sheng Yue exuded a depressed aura, "What's wrong with you?"
"Why did she refund my money?" Sheng Yue didn't care at first.
At least when he received the refund information, he was indifferent.
"Inquiry fee. I transferred her one million star coins and she returned it."
Pei Yin said angrily: "Hey, you don't want any money? Then you can continue to give it away, learn from other people's bad habits, and coax her to accept it."
He snorted coldly, "Since you want to play, let's play big."
Pei Yin turned around and anonymously sent all the information to Jian Yu.
He looked at the message Xi Yu sent last night: Who sent it?
No investigation? Then he doesn't mind muddying the water a little more.
Pei Yin sneered and replied: Who do you think sent it?
After thinking for a moment, Pei Yin clicked into the group chat again. The others were not in the Imperial City, but Duan Fei was there.
In terms of strength, Xi Yu ranks first, but Duan Feiye is no less sinister than Ling Yanzhi.
Pei Yin doesn't want to fight for any woman. He just wants to watch the dog eat the dog and watch them bite the dog.
He sent out a message in a troubled manner: go to the college forum.
Get a reply in seconds.
Duan Feiye: Boring.
Pei Yin directly sent him a few links to posts, including the name Ling Yanzhi, and he was still bored.
Seeing that there was no news from the other side, he closed the Star Brain with satisfaction.
He can't be the only one bored.
Sheng Yue raised his eyes lightly, with a dull expression on his face, "What did you do?"
Pei Yin said confidently: "Shake people."
I came over to tell him early in the morning, didn't you just want him to join the same camp and recruit a few more people to fight against Ling Gou?
Sheng Yue understood Ling Yanzhi's character.
